$comment: Project policy for the hooks in this directory. Schema, defaults and fail modes: docs/hatchery/decisions/0006-hook-policy-file.md. Usage is per meter (5-hour holds at 60, weekly at 98, no deny line). The privacy scan (privacy-scan.js, guard rule 20, the pre-push hook under git.hooksPath; ADR 0018) passes each identity listed in privacy.identities, the placeholder user names user, alice and bob, and the service accounts broodforge (the droplet's) and broodforge-engine, both named after the project. The post-edit hook runs gofmt -w on every edited Go file. Check with: node .claude/hooks/policy.js
